In summary, the entire analysis of this Project has left doubts of sufficient data to truly assess the complex nature of the lake and stream system and assign values to the negative impacts. It is, therefore, requested that sufficient time be allowed for the development of all necessary factual information on the points stated above prior to a decision on licensing.
Staff concludes that it is not in the best interest of the public to defer the processing of this application until studies are completed which may affect or modify load forecasts which have been made on the bacis of the most reliable information already available at this time.
